blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Central Abbotsford. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Central Abbotsford fell from 294 in June to 256 in September (−12.9%), and 167 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 44.8% of Abbotsford’s 572 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Central Abbotsford?
Central Abbotsford also had 70 houses listed and 12 sold in September, against 256 condos and townhomes listed. The Central Abbotsford houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Central Abbotsford?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 256 condos and townhomes listed in Central Abbotsford. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Central Abbotsford a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Central Abbotsford had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Central Abbotsford from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 167 condos and townhomes sold in Central Abbotsford over those 4 months, out of 318 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
